entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, 20% off the BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 (1.8TH/s) on orders of $100+, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.

Two weeks in Portugal with your wife sounds lovely. Air Transat can be strict about carry-on size, so a good bag matters.

When you were choosing a carry-on, what mattered most to you: size, durability, looks, or price?
Mostly it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.

Heavy bags are the worst, especially when you're hauling them through airports. Light and within the limit, got it.

Besides us, where else are you looking at carry-ons, like other stores, brands, or Amazon?
I looked at Samsonite on Amazon and something a Costco. But the Bugatti looks nicer.

Good to know, the Bugatti wins on looks. Style matters when it's your travel bag for two weeks.

So what's holding you back from buying it today: price, shipping time, returns, or something else?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And if shipping is fast enough before the trip,

Dimensions and shipping both matter, since you're flying in November. I'll point to the details on the page. Sizes are on the product page, and I don't have shipping times, so the shipping policy page has those.

Do you know roughly when you'd need it by?

Take your time looking at the description. Since you're flying in November, there should still be some time.

How did you first find HeliumDeploy?
I saw an Instagram ad a few days ago. That's how I found you.

Instagram, got it. Thanks for sharing that.

Our reward code is for a small home Bitcoin miner, so I'm curious. Would noise or heat from something like that worry you?
No. I think that covers it. Thanks a lot. Bye.
Thanks so much for your time, and enjoy Portugal with your wife. Press "End call" and your code will appear on screen. Goodbye!
Whenever you're ready, just press "End call" and your code will be on your screen. Goodbye!
